history.summary: A 1227 sqft 999-year leasehold 3BR in D23 Bukit Panjang at $1621 PSF / $1.99M, just 310m from DT1 Bukit Panjang MRT. The URA series is the most robust in this batch (31 txns, ~5.2% CAGR), but the asking PSF is a notable ~11% ABOVE the project's $1458 median.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely strong fundamentals — 999-yr tenure (effectively freehold), 310m to Downtown Line, a 31-txn URA series with ~5.2% CAGR, and large 1227 sqft 3BR layout. But the asking $1621 PSF is ~11% above the $1458 project median, eroding the margin of safety, and Bukit Panjang (D23 OCR) has a more limited appreciation ceiling than RCR. Sub-$2M quantum keeps liquidity reasonable. The overpricing offsets the otherwise solid case — Neutral.
red_flags: Asking ~11% above project URA median PSF ($1621 vs $1458)
D23 Bukit Panjang OCR — lower appreciation ceiling than RCR districts
2006 build — 20 years old, ageing despite 999-yr tenure
$1.99M for a D23 3BR is near the top of what the location supports
catalysts: 310m to DT1 Bukit Panjang MRT (Downtown Line + LRT interchange)
Strong 31-txn URA series showing ~5.2% historical CAGR
